text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Guys, do you read me?!
It looks like we've defeated one of the monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
聞こえる！？
ひとまず一匹、
撃破に成功したみたい！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
And yet... A mighty torrent of magic
still flows toward the Kaiser!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが……
いまだに覇瞳皇帝に対して、
魔力が流れ込んでいます……！

text_block_list.name: Omniscient Kaiser
text_block_list.text:
Hahah...!
What did I tell you? Those monsters are magical constructs!
They'll regenerate in no time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ……！
言ったでしょう、
そいつらは魔力で出来た傀儡にすぎない！
何度でも立ち上がるわ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're definitely depleting them.
It's a battle of endurance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
少しは削れてるみたい……
我慢勝負ね！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさん、
お願いしますっ！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text: W-we'll do our best to clean them up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
がんばってお掃除します～……！
